scores.evidence: Weeks 1–2: GitHub App, webhook ingestion, state machine, triage classifier in shadow mode, and building the historical evaluation set.
scores.rationale: Milestones go roughly substrate → triage → sandbox → coding, but guardrails/cost controls land in weeks 8–10, after the coding loop, and no proof gates between phases.

scores.evidence: Weeks 1–2: GitHub App, webhook ingestion, state machine, triage classifier in shadow mode
scores.rationale: Phase 1 is an end-to-end thin slice (webhook to shadow triage), but it writes nothing and isn't a production path to a real output.

scores.evidence: Licensing and data policy for sending code to model providers needs legal sign-off.
scores.rationale: Some open questions are listed, but there is no table of irreversible decisions with defaults and flip conditions; stack choices are 'or' options.

scores.evidence: GitHub App, webhook ingestion, state machine, triage classifier in shadow mode
scores.rationale: Foundational ingestion/state machine comes before leaf features, but blast radius ordering is not explicit within phases, and policy layer is deferred.

scores.evidence: Weeks 8–10: Handling review feedback, plan-approval flow, dashboard, cost controls, red-team pass.
scores.rationale: Security content is strong in design (sandbox, least-privilege, policy layer), but milestones put red-teaming and cost controls late rather than threading them per phase.

scores.evidence: Weeks 8–10: ... dashboard, cost controls, red-team pass.
scores.rationale: Observability is a standalone section and dashboard is scheduled late; Phase 0 does not explicitly include tracing, though shadow logging exists.
No treatment of reproducible builds, pinned environments, prompt/model versioning or data snapshots across phases beyond held-out eval sets.

scores.evidence: Events go into a durable queue (SQS, Pub/Sub or Redis Streams) so retries are idempotent.
scores.rationale: Resilience (durable queue, persisted state, budgets, circuit breaker, flaky-test rerun) is described in design but not tied to each phase.

scores.evidence: L0, Shadow: Triage runs but writes nothing.
scores.rationale: Has guardrails, budgets, human approval, and autonomy levels, but milestones build triage/retrieval and coding before cost controls and red-teaming, and memory/routing/feedback ordering isn't addressed.

scores.evidence: Out of scope at first: merging its own PRs, security vulnerabilities, breaking API changes, architecture decisions
scores.rationale: Out-of-scope list and autonomy level promotion criteria exist, but pull-forward conditions for deferred items are mostly absent.

note: Strong, detailed design with good safety and autonomy ladder, but milestones put guardrails, observability and cost controls late and lack explicit decision gates, reproducibility and deferral triggers.
